subjects.title: Crossed Belt Drive
subjects.seoDescription: Explore a crossed belt drive interactively: reversed rotary transmission, ideal speed ratio, belt geometry, and Brown movement 002 context.
subjects.summary: Cross the belt between two parallel pulleys and the driven shaft reverses direction. In the ideal no-slip model, the pulley-size ratio is unchanged; only its sign changes.

facts.label: Geometry condition
facts.value: Center distance must exceed the sum of the pitch radii for the ideal crossed tangent construction.

facts.label: Assumptions
facts.value: Massless, inextensible belt; no slip; fixed coplanar centers; no belt self-contact or lateral dynamics.

source.excerpt: Differs from 1 in the substitution of a crossed belt for the open one.

editorial.heading: Brown turns reversal into a control system.
